scopo: Prova completa del flusso nuovo (fase D): Avenger alla scala unica, con il pilota al volante.

stato.nota: Scheda in bozza: le parti specifiche dei prompt sono da approvare. La dima arriva con la fase C; senza dima non si genera nulla.

specifico.gemini: The model: the Avenger, a low and long post-apocalyptic muscle car for a desert racing board game. Long flat hood, low roofline, wide stance, an open cockpit behind a low armoured windscreen with one driver seat and a steering wheel, a standing platform for a gunner at the back. Welded armour plates, side exhausts, a ram bar at the front.
specifico.meshy: Low poly game-ready body of a low and long post-apocalyptic muscle car, long flat hood, low roofline, open cockpit with one seat and a steering wheel, standing platform at the back, welded armour plates, side exhausts, front ram bar. No wheels, empty wheel arches. No weapons, a flat round mounting plate at the back. Neutral light grey painted panels, dark iron frame.

specifico.gemini: The model: a wide muscle car wheel, a fat road tyre with a worn tread on a dark steel rim with five bolts.
specifico.meshy: Low poly game-ready muscle car wheel, fat worn road tyre, dark steel rim with a centred hub and five bolts.

specifico.gemini: The model: the pintle mount of a heavy machine gun, a short thick steel post on a round rotating base.
specifico.meshy: Low poly game-ready pintle mount for a heavy machine gun, short thick steel post on a round rotating base, dark rusty iron.

specifico.gemini: The model: a heavy machine gun aimed by hand, with an ammunition belt and box, a small armoured gun shield and two rear spade grips.
specifico.meshy: Low poly game-ready heavy machine gun with ammunition belt and box, small armoured gun shield, two rear spade grips, dark rusty iron.

decisioni.testo: Scala unica 1:125: Avenger lunga 4,8 m (38 mm sul tavolo), alta 1,2 m, bassa e lunga.
Vernice in un solo grigio neutro; ruggine, piastre di riparazione e sporco non prendono il colore del giocatore.
